title: Golden Curse Episode 10 Indonesia, English Sub
description:
English
Golden Curse (2026) / God of Wealth Dou Zhanlong
When Taoist Cui Laodao attempts to read the Book of Heaven, he accidentally releases a Golden Toad that gathers treasures. Fascinated by the prosperity of the human world, the Golden Toad chooses to reincarnate as a human, becoming Dou Zhanlong.
In order to evade a heavenly calamity, the Golden Toad tears apart Dou Zhanlong's three souls and seven spirits, creating nine incarnations that are scattered across different locations and parallel timelines. Whenever one Dou Zhanlong dies, another incarnation takes his place. Together, they are destined to endure the terrifying cycle known as the “Nine Deaths and Thirteen Disasters.”
The story follows the first incarnation of Dou Zhanlong as he embarks on a journey of revenge, treasure hunting, and uncovering ancient mysteries. After his sister is killed, Dou Zhanlong sets out to find the truth and destroy the enemy responsible, eventually becoming entangled in a dangerous world of folk magic, supernatural legends, hidden treasures, and mysterious creatures.
Set against the backdrop of Republic-era China, Golden Curse combines treasure-hunting adventure with Chinese folklore, dark humor, mystery, fantasy, and traditional Chinese horror.
Indonesia
Ketika Taois Cui Laodao mencoba membaca Kitab Langit, ia tanpa sengaja melepaskan seekor Katak Emas Pembawa Harta. Karena terpesona oleh kemakmuran dunia manusia, makhluk tersebut memilih bereinkarnasi sebagai manusia dan menjadi Dou Zhanlong.
Untuk menghindari bencana dari langit, Katak Emas tersebut memecah tiga jiwa dan tujuh roh Dou Zhanlong di dalam tubuhnya, menciptakan sembilan wujud yang tersebar di berbagai tempat dan ruang-waktu paralel. Setiap kali salah satu Dou Zhanlong mati, wujud berikutnya akan menggantikannya. Bersama-sama, mereka harus menghadapi takdir berupa “Sembilan Kematian dan Tiga Belas Bencana.”
Kisah ini mengikuti wujud pertama Dou Zhanlong dalam perjalanannya mengungkap rahasia, mencari harta, menghadapi kekuatan mistis, dan membalas dendam atas kematian kakaknya. Perjalanannya membawanya ke dunia penuh legenda rakyat, ilmu gaib, pencarian harta, serta berbagai makhluk dan kekuatan misterius.
Dengan latar Tiongkok era Republik, Golden Curse memadukan petualangan mencari harta dengan horor khas cerita rakyat Tiongkok, humor gelap, misteri, dan fantasi.
